clue.text: Get rid of surplus weight

parts.note: reads like a dieter shedding pounds, but describes pulling something out or obtaining a concentrate by removing the unwanted bulk

explanation.surface: Advice to someone trying to slim down.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull out or draw off something, discarding the bulk around it, is the verb's core sense, as in drawing a tooth or juice.

clue.text: A head among teachers

indicators.note: the answer sits among the letters of the word teachers

explanation.surface: One headteacher placed in a staffroom full of teachers.
explanation.definitionFit: Per person, as in 'five pounds a head', is a synonym of the distributive word for every one.

clue.text: Break in, being unafraid of human contact

definitions.meaning: to break in a horse is to train it to accept handling
describes a domesticated animal that does not shy from people

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from domestication: the verb for training an animal and the adjective for one used to people.

clue.text: Blown to bits, a cat dies in agony

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

indicators.note: agony suggests writhing and twisting, so the letters of dies are contorted

explanation.surface: A gruesome picture of a cat expiring in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A cat dies' reads as a sad event; the cat is a tom, and only 'dies' is rearranged by 'in agony'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reduced to tiny particles, as by an explosion or a spray, has been broken into minute fragments.

clue.text: Lifting the foot

parts.note: ft is the standard abbreviation for foot as a unit of length

explanation.surface: An instruction to raise one's foot, as at the doctor or in exercise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lifting' is slang for stealing, not raising.
explanation.definitionFit: To lift is informal for to steal, so lifting as a noun is stealing.

clue.text: Divine is providing one in the last month

indicators.note: the two short words are placed in the middle of the month's abbreviation

parts.note: December, abbreviated Dec, is the final month of the year
providing means if, as a condition
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Something becomes divine only if it happens in December.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is' is only a link; 'in' places the condition word and the numeral within the month.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means godlike or making divine, from the Latin word for a god.

clue.text: It's evenly distributed as a name for either sex

indicators.note: the letters of evenly are spread around into a new order

explanation.surface: A remark that a certain name is shared evenly between boys and girls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evenly distributed' looks like the meaning; 'distributed' rearranges EVENLY.
explanation.definitionFit: The name was borne by men such as the novelist Waugh and by women, so it serves both sexes.

clue.text: Encouraging indication of support gifted

parts.note: a favour can be a rosette or badge worn to show support
able means talented or gifted

explanation.surface: A gift given as a sign of backing is heartening.
explanation.definitionFit: Promising signs or a positive report are encouraging, which is what favourable means.

clue.text: They're not employed to mind their own business

definitions.text: They're not employed to mind their own business

parts.words: They're not employed to mind their own business
parts.note: minding one's own business usually means not interfering; here it means looking after premises, which these people do for others

explanation.surface: A jibe at people paid to keep out of others' affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Janitors and building custodians look after property belonging to someone else, not their own.

clue.text: Settles scores

definitions.meaning: calms down or puts in order, as one does one's thoughts
writes music, as a composer writes scores

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both calms or arranges oneself and writes music.

clue.text: Tennis player seen in church

definitions.meaning: the player who puts the ball into play
an acolyte who assists the priest at the altar

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the tennis player delivering a serve, the other the altar assistant at Mass.

clue.text: Broken toe holds up Edward in Swan Lake role

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold another piece inside
a broken toe is out of shape, so its letters are reassembled
in a down clue, up means the piece is read bottom to top

parts.note: Ted is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: A ballet dancer injured just as she plays the lead in Swan Lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Holds' is the container signal and 'up' reverses Edward's short form in this down clue. The grid printed ODOTTE, a misprint for the ballet heroine.
explanation.definitionFit: The heroine of Tchaikovsky's ballet is the Swan Queen of that name.

clue.text: Nothing to wear for an age-old celebration

definitions.text: Nothing to wear for an age-old celebration

parts.words: Nothing to wear for an age-old celebration
parts.note: sounds like a party with no outfit, but means bare skin, the outfit one was born in

explanation.surface: Someone lamenting they have no outfit for a long-standing festivity.
explanation.definitionFit: Nakedness is jokingly the suit worn on the day of one's birth, hence nothing on at all.

clue.text: Dickensian captain, proverbial drinker, found on the 18

parts.note: Captain Cuttle is a character in Dickens's Dombey and Son
to drink like a fish is the proverb

explanation.surface: A Dickens sea captain with a drinking habit turns up at the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 is the answer to 18 down, the coast, where this sea creature may wash up.
explanation.definitionFit: This ten-armed cephalopod's chalky bone is commonly found washed up on beaches.

clue.text: A number shown to be justified

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
indicated means shown or pointed out

explanation.surface: A figure has been proven correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone cleared or proved right has been shown to be justified, the synonym's core sense.

clue.text: It retains its faculties

parts.note: retaining one's faculties suggests an alert old person; here faculties are academic departments

explanation.surface: Praise for a sharp-minded elderly person.
explanation.definitionFit: Institutions of higher learning are divided into faculties of arts, science and so on.

clue.text: Check a word that is an anagram of itself

indicators.text: a word that is an anagram of
indicators.note: states outright that the answer is a rearrangement of the following word

explanation.surface: A puzzle about verifying a word that rearranges into itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Itself' seems to refer back to the word, but it is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To stifle is to suppress or hold back, a sense of check as a verb.

clue.text: Vessel that had its full complement of mates

definitions.text: Vessel that had its full complement of mates

parts.words: Vessel that had its full complement of mates
parts.note: a ship's mates are officers; here they are animal pairs taken aboard two by two

explanation.surface: A ship fully crewed with officers.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's boat carried the animals in mated pairs, so it was full of couples.

clue.text: Beach shoes are adjusted for it

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are adjusted into a new order

explanation.surface: Footwear altered to suit walking on the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: The coastal strip between land and sea is a beach.

clue.text: He means to make hay while the sun shines

definitions.text: He means to make hay while the sun shines

parts.words: He means to make hay while the sun shines
parts.note: reads like an opportunist named by a man's name, but is a farming verb for spreading grass to dry

explanation.surface: A description of a man determined to seize opportunities.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to turn and spread mown grass so it dries into hay in the sun.

clue.text: Graves may be found below ground level here

definitions.text: Graves may be found below ground level here

parts.words: Graves may be found below ground level here
parts.note: suggests a cemetery, but Graves is a Bordeaux wine stored in an underground store

explanation.surface: A description of a crypt or burial site.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottles such as Graves, a Bordeaux red or white, are kept in a basement store for wine.

clue.text: Original spares may be few and far between

indicators.note: an original version is a novel one, so the letters of spares are made new

explanation.surface: Genuine spare parts are hard to come by.
explanation.definitionFit: Thinly scattered and scarce things are few and far between.

clue.text: Entertainer is to go places when free

indicators.note: set free, the letters of the phrase rearrange themselves

explanation.surface: A performer who travels about when not booked.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase IS TO GO PLACES is set free and rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Houdini-style performers who wriggle out of chains and locks are stage entertainers.

clue.text: Think of Americans

parts.note: seems to ask you to bring Americans to mind, but means the word an American uses for think

explanation.surface: An invitation to consider people from the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage 'I reckon' or 'I suppose' is commonly expressed with this verb for think.

clue.text: Let it be one sort of square inside another

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a set square is another drawing instrument
a T-square is a drawing instrument

explanation.surface: A geometry-set remark about one square within another.
explanation.definitionFit: The proofreader's Latin instruction means let it stand, cancelling a correction.

clue.text: Kind face of the press

definitions.meaning: printing letters, as in a typeface

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a sort or category and also printed characters on a press.

clue.text: Detain one after another, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the phrase is to be heard, not read

parts.note: in turn means one after another

explanation.surface: Holding people in sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: To confine someone, especially in wartime, without trial is to detain them.

clue.text: Faithfully combining love and duty

indicators.note: the two words are combined and mixed together

explanation.surface: A description of loyal devotion blending affection and obligation.
explanation.definitionFit: Piously or loyally is the adverb's sense, close to faithfully.

clue.text: Was shifty and naturally guarded

definitions.meaning: enclosed by a living boundary of shrubs

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both was evasive in answering and enclosed with a row of bushes.

clue.text: Novel articles put in case

parts.note: She is a novel by H. Rider Haggard
a is the indefinite article
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Fictional items being boxed up.
explanation.definitionFit: To insert a blade into its scabbard is to put it in its case.
